Faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
Faq.subtitle: Team with a strong tech experience who always gets your work done.

items.q: What DevOps work can your team do?
items.a: Our DevOps experts can automate almost anything: set up Continuous Integration and Delivery/Deployment (CI/CD), high availability, fail-over and auto-scaling, analyze infrastructure for cost optimization, handle data migrations and conversions, and minimize regional latency.

Setting up alarms; receiving, verifying and escalating alerts and opening tickets; preparing site reliability reports; web page scans; manual application checks on various devices; and retrieving logs via scripts, analyzing them and reporting findings.

items.q: What is included in the Manage plan?
items.a: Managing includes monitoring, upgrades, backups, SSL, DNS and troubleshooting of development, QA, UAT and production environments. Our team has decades of experience managing applications and cloud infrastructure, and ramps up management tasks gradually as it learns your application stack.

items.q: How do plans and hours work?
items.a: Hours in a plan are expected to be used over a month. In urgent situations or emergencies, hours may be used earlier, and the team can work additional hours if required. Monitoring or Manage features can be removed from a plan if not needed. Plans can be upgraded, downgraded or cancelled with 30 days' notice.

items.q: No plan — just a one-off task. Will you do it?
items.a: Yes. We prefer customers who can stay with us longer, but we do take on one-off and emergency tasks. Fees for these depend on complexity and urgency, and the hourly rate is higher than in our plans.

Yes. We provide junior to senior engineers for engagements of 3+ months. They work 40 hours a week, cover some hours in your time zone or on-site, and have access to architecture-level support from our team when needed.

items.q: What is your response time and uptime guarantee?
items.a: Our DevOps team responds within 2 to 4 hours during normal business hours, and by agreement can handle tasks that can't be done during business hours. Our 24/7 team can respond within one hour down to under 15 minutes, depending on your requirements. We set up PagerDuty, OpsGenie and similar tools, and can offer SLA-based uptime guarantees for production after a few months of onboarding.

We serve financial, health and e-commerce clients requiring SOC 2, PCI, HIPAA, GDPR and ISO 27001 compliance. We deploy multiple layers of security, from secure workstations to request logging on our office network, routinely audit our processes and add tools to strengthen our defenses. Our employees sign NDAs and other data security and privacy agreements.

After a free 30-minute consultation, Asistensia sends a commercial proposal. Once accepted, we sign a Service Agreement/NDA and form a team for your stack. We adapt to your workflow and respond via Slack, Jira, Asana, Microsoft Teams or email. Time is logged in Toggl, monthly reports are available on request, and invoices are issued every 30 days, payable by credit card, ACH or wire transfer.

items.q: How soon can you start on our tasks?
items.a: We can start within 24 hours of signing the NDA/Agreement. Understanding your application and infrastructure takes time — depending on complexity, it takes from a day to a few weeks to complete different types of tasks. A gradual ramp-up works best.
